payload.blocks: Every portfolio write and land from the main checkout, and closing the done pkm locate plan. A commit made there now would silently revert 20 commits.
payload.headline: Main checkout HEAD moved to de446a21f but its index and files stayed at f5514fd6c; run one read-tree to finish it?

parts.cause: Before the write I ran touch on plans/261017-1313-fgos-platform-program-board/log.md (mtime only). The door's 'git read-tree -m -u f5514fd6c de446a21f' (packages/git/rust/src/refs.rs:893) refused it as 'not uptodate' after the ref CAS had already landed. My session cannot write .git, and no lead:SUPERVISOR is live.

options.does: In /home/vantt/projects/forgent run: git update-index --refresh; git read-tree -m -u f5514fd6c de446a21f; then git status should list only your own 3 modified files and plans/261122-0118-heads-stable-and-able/plan.md
options.gain: Checkout matches HEAD, local edits kept, writes and lands work again
options.harm: None known; read-tree refuses rather than overwrite a dirty file
options.label: You run the read-tree

options.does: Open the unconfined supervisor lead so I can hand it this and future confined chores
options.gain: Also clears the two older questions that need unconfined commands
options.harm: One more live session and its account
options.label: Start an unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR

parts.recommendation: You run the read-tree: it is the exact step the door failed to finish, and it keeps your local edits.

scope.allows: Finishing the checkout update of the main checkout from f5514fd6c to de446a21f.
scope.forbids: Reset --hard, discarding your modified files, or any other change to main.

parts.what: My backlog write (session write plans/backlog.md) caught main up to origin: the ref moved f5514fd6c -> de446a21f, then the checkout update failed. git status now shows 30 staged files that are the reverse of those 20 commits. Nothing is lost; the files on disk are the old tree.
